subject.title: [Feature]: Inline agent widgets in web chat via client-capability-gated tools

question: Should OpenClaw accept client-capability-gated tool availability plus a bundled Canvas `show_widget` web-chat widget tool as the supported direction for this issue?
rationale: The work creates a plugin-visible tool API and a model-authored markup sandbox boundary, so automation cannot safely approve the product and security policy on code evidence alone.

options.title: Review the linked implementation PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101840 as the candidate path, fixing its blockers and explicitly accepting the API and sandbox boundary before merge.

options.title: Redesign the capability API first
options.body: Keep this issue open but pause the implementation PR until maintainers choose a narrower or different client-capability contract.

options.title: Reject bundled widget support
options.body: Close the implementation path and route widget experimentation to external plugins or ClawHub until a missing core API is proven.

recommendation.title: Review the linked implementation PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101840 as the candidate path, fixing its blockers and explicitly accepting the API and sandbox boundary before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He is tied to the current implementation candidate and current-main area history for the gateway, UI, Canvas, and hosted-embed surfaces involved.
